capabilities: Extracts claims and typed relations from notes into a knowledge graph
Surfaces contradictions, gaps and forgotten connections in a review inbox
Serves the graph to external LLMs over MCP
Exports the graph as JSON-LD or GraphML
extras: Freemium: free plan covers one initial indexing, 30 credits per month and the weekly report; extraction beyond that needs a paid plan bought outside the plugin. Graph browsing, export, weekly report and local MCP work without a hub account. Collecting from folders outside the vault and from Bear is desktop-only.
problem: Notes pile up without anyone noticing where they contradict each other, link to concepts that have no note, or repeat the same idea in different places.

relations.evidence: external AIs such as Claude or GPT connect to your knowledge over MCP
Notes outside Obsidian (plain Markdown folders, Logseq, Bear, OneNote, Evernote, Google Drive, Dropbox) join through a single Connect button
Bring your own endpoint (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio) and note content never leaves your machine

requires.name: OntoFlow paid plan for extra extraction credits
Local LLM endpoint (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio)

summary: AI knowledge-graph plugin that extracts claims and relations from notes and surfaces contradictions, gaps and forgotten connections for review.
